Section 1Defining stress days¶

Section 2Grid reliance on the fleet¶

As more batteries are installed, changes to the grid reliance on them to meet peak demand is expected. We'll see how much of the change over the past two years.

How much of peak demand has the fleet met over time?¶

Is reliance increasing because demand changed, or because batteries do more?¶

Is battery discharge growing only because there are more batteries?¶

How much energy does the grid need from the fleet during ESROI?¶

"Daily need" can be defined under two definitions:

  • ESROI fleet net discharge
  • ESROI net demand minus available non-battery capacity
